rows.quote: Genetic associations for osteoporosis were obtained from the FinnGen consortium (DF12 release), comprising 10,461 osteoporosis cases and 473,264 controls (https://r12.finngen.fi/pheno/M13_OSTEOPOROSIS).
rows.coder_note: 'FinnGen consortium (DF12 release)' with the r12.finngen.fi address is release 12 in another written form (rule A); the endpoint case and control counts are endpoint-specific and no conflict (rule H); nothing indicates a meta-analysis with UK Biobank or MVP.

Reference 13 is Sun 2023 (DOI verified), whose source has several dictionary rows; the sentence gives 2,923 proteins, 54,219 participants and Olink Explore 3072, and 54,219 is the sample size of no row, so no attribute separates the rows (rule E not met).

rows.quote: The second dataset came from deCODE Genetics, comprising 4,719 plasma proteins measured in 35,559 Icelandic individuals using SomaScan version 4 [14].
rows.reference_quote: Ferkingstad E Sulem P Atlason BA Large-scale integration of the plasma proteome with genetics and disease Nat Genet 2021 53 1712 21 10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w 34857953
rows.coder_note: The sentence attributes the deCODE dataset to reference 14, whose DOI 10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w is the Ferkingstad 2021 row's and belongs to no other row; the sentence also gives that row's exact 35,559 with SomaScan version 4, and nothing in the paper conflicts.
